contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

While the sequence is unclear: My ceiling and the downstairs neighbour's ceiling are wet again; One plumber wrote that it is the cold-water line; another named a drain; The manager acknowledges the problem but has not arranged joint access; this is how I recorded it.

Regarding “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, my notes show: the leak source remains unresolved; for the request “coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly”: some dates are not yet in a reliable order; on “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, I need a concise assessment first; also unresolved: the affected units; these points make up my first report.

I am specifically asking for: coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly; in particular, I need clarity about the affected units and which dates reliably establish the chronology.

I need the chronology checked; Before acting I need to know the leak source; I can then plan how to proceed.

I became aware of the problem on 01 January 2025.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Chronology still unclear: recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes
